proposed_sites.reason: Module-level assignment to openai.api_key; must be replaced with explicit client construction via OpenAI(api_key=...).
Module-level namespaced ChatCompletion.create call inside the chatcompletion() helper function; must become client.chat.completions.create(...).

considered_and_rejected.reason: Dict-style subscript access on the response object is a downstream effect of the v1 response object shape change, but does not itself contain an openai.<Namespace>.<method> call, an openai.error.* reference, or a module-level auth assignment, so it does not match any of the 3 defined patterns.
